questions.ko: 독일에 있는 고객사는 몇 곳인가요?
questions.en: How many customers are located in Germany?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany';

questions.ko: 단종된 제품 목록을 보여주세요.
questions.en: List the discontinued products.
questions.sql: SELECT product_id, product_name FROM products WHERE discontinued = 1 ORDER BY product_name;

questions.ko: 재고가 재주문 기준 아래로 떨어진 판매 중 제품은?
questions.en: Which active products have stock below their reorder level?
questions.hint: 판매 중 = discontinued = 0. 재주문 기준 = reorder_level.
questions.sql: SELECT product_name, units_in_stock, reorder_level, units_on_order FROM products WHERE discontinued = 0 AND units_in_stock < reorder_level ORDER BY product_name;

questions.ko: 단가가 가장 비싼 제품 10개를 알려주세요.
questions.en: Show the 10 most expensive products.
questions.sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products ORDER BY unit_price DESC, product_name LIMIT 10;

questions.ko: 국가별 고객 수를 많은 순으로 보여주세요.
questions.en: Number of customers per country, most first.
questions.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country;

questions.ko: 1997년에 접수된 주문은 몇 건인가요?
questions.en: How many orders were placed in 1997?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '1998-01-01';

questions.ko: 직원들의 이름, 직책, 입사일을 입사 순서대로 보여주세요.
questions.en: List employees with title and hire date, earliest hire first.
questions.sql: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS employee_name, title, hire_date FROM employees ORDER BY hire_date, employee_id;

questions.ko: 운송비가 500달러 이상인 주문을 보여주세요.
questions.en: Show orders with freight of 500 or more.
questions.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, freight FROM orders WHERE freight >= 500 ORDER BY freight DESC;

questions.ko: 카테고리별 제품 수와 평균 단가를 알려주세요.
questions.en: Product count and average unit price per category.
questions.sql: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count, ROUND(AVG(p.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY c.category_name;

questions.ko: 1997년 월별 주문 건수를 보여주세요.
questions.en: Monthly order count in 1997.
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date)::int AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

questions.ko: 배송사별 주문 건수와 평균 운송비는?
questions.en: Order count and average freight by shipper.
questions.sql: SELECT s.company_name AS shipper, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(o.freight)::numeric, 2) AS avg_freight FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via GROUP BY s.company_name ORDER BY s.company_name;

questions.ko: 1997년 총 매출은 얼마인가요?
questions.en: What was total revenue in 1997?
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01';

questions.ko: 연도별 매출과 주문 건수 추이를 보여주세요.
questions.en: Revenue and order count by year.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

questions.ko: 공급업체 국가별로 공급하는 제품 수는?
questions.en: Number of products supplied per supplier country.
questions.sql: SELECT s.country, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id GROUP BY s.country ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.country;

questions.ko: 주문을 20건 이상 한 고객사는 어디인가요?
questions.en: Which customers placed 20 or more orders?
questions.sql: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.company_name;

questions.ko: 전체 주문 중 요청일보다 늦게 배송된 주문의 비율은?
questions.en: What share of shipped orders shipped after the required date?
questions.hint: 지연 = shipped_date > required_date. 미배송(shipped_date IS NULL) 주문은 제외.
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shipped_date > required_date) AS late_orders, COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE shipped_date > required_date) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders WHERE shipped_date IS NOT NULL;

questions.ko: 1997년 매출 상위 5개 고객사는?
questions.en: Top 5 customers by revenue in 1997.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: SELECT c.company_name, c.country, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.company_name, c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

questions.ko: 1997년 직원별 판매 실적(매출, 주문 건수)을 보여주세요.
questions.en: Sales by employee in 1997 (revenue and order count).
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

questions.ko: 카테고리별 전체 매출을 높은 순으로 보여주세요.
questions.en: Total revenue by category, highest first.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

questions.ko: 판매 수량 기준으로 가장 많이 팔린 제품 10개는?
questions.en: Top 10 products by quantity sold.
questions.sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(od.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 10;

questions.ko: 해산물(Seafood) 제품을 공급하는 업체와 국가를 알려주세요.
questions.en: Which suppliers (and countries) supply Seafood products?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.company_name, s.country FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Seafood' ORDER BY s.company_name;

questions.ko: 각 직원과 그 직원의 상사 이름을 보여주세요.
questions.en: Show each employee with their manager's name.
questions.hint: employees.reports_to = 상사의 employee_id. 상사가 없는 직원도 포함.
questions.sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, e.title, m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS manager_name FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.employee_id = e.reports_to ORDER BY e.employee_id;

questions.ko: 배송사별로 지연 배송 건수와 지연율을 비교해 주세요.
questions.en: Compare late shipments and late rate by shipper.
questions.hint: 지연 = shipped_date > required_date. 미배송 주문 제외.
questions.sql: SELECT s.company_name AS shipper, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) AS late_orders, COUNT(*) AS shipped_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via WHERE o.shipped_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.company_name ORDER BY late_pct DESC;

questions.ko: 직원별 담당 지역(Region)과 담당 테리토리 수를 보여주세요.
questions.en: Each employee's region(s) and number of territories.
questions.hint: employees → employee_territories → territories → region. 일부 Northwind 배포본은 region_description에 공백 패딩이 있어 TRIM 권장.
questions.sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT TRIM(r.region_description), ', ') AS regions, COUNT(*) AS territory_count FROM employees e JOIN employee_territories et ON et.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN territories t ON t.territory_id = et.territory_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = t.region_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY e.employee_id;

questions.ko: 한 번도 주문하지 않은 고객사는?
questions.en: Which customers have never placed an order?
questions.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, c.country FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) ORDER BY c.company_name;

questions.ko: 전체 평균 단가보다 비싼 제품은 몇 개이고 어떤 것들인가요?
questions.en: Products priced above the overall average unit price.
questions.sql: SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price > (SELECT AVG(unit_price) FROM products) ORDER BY unit_price DESC;

questions.ko: 카테고리마다 가장 비싼 제품 하나씩 보여주세요.
questions.en: The most expensive product in each category.
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.category_name) c.category_name, p.product_name, p.unit_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id ORDER BY c.category_name, p.unit_price DESC, p.product_name;

questions.ko: 1997년 고객사 매출 순위 상위 10곳과 전체 매출 대비 비중을 보여주세요.
questions.en: Top 10 customers by 1997 revenue with rank and share of total.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.company_name) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk, company_name, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((100 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER ())::numeric, 2) AS share_pct FROM cust ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 10;

questions.ko: 1997년 월별 매출과 전월 대비 증감률을 보여주세요.
questions.en: 1997 monthly revenue with month-over-month growth.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue, ROUND((100 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month))::numeric, 2) AS mom_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;

questions.ko: 국가별로 매출 1위 고객사를 알려주세요.
questions.en: Top customer by revenue in each country.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT c.country, c.company_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.country ORDER BY SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country, c.company_name) SELECT country, company_name, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

rows: Furia Bacalhau e Frutos do Mar

questions.ko: 주문당 평균 품목 수와 평균 주문 금액은?
questions.en: Average line items per order and average order value.
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date.
questions.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT od.order_id, COUNT(*) AS line_items, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS order_value FROM order_details od GROUP BY od.order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(line_items), 2) AS avg_line_items, ROUND(AVG(order_value)::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM per_order;

questions.ko: 주문을 5건 이상 한 고객 중 평균 주문 간격이 가장 짧은 10곳은?
questions.en: Among customers with 5+ orders, the 10 with the shortest average days between orders.
questions.hint: 평균 주문 간격 = (마지막 주문일 - 첫 주문일) / (주문 건수 - 1).
questions.sql: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order, ROUND((MAX(o.order_date) - MIN(o.order_date))::numeric / (COUNT(*) - 1), 1) AS avg_days_between FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.company_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_days_between, c.company_name LIMIT 10;

questions.ko: 같은 주문에서 함께 가장 많이 팔린 제품 조합 Top 10은?
questions.en: Top 10 product pairs most often bought in the same order.
questions.sql: SELECT p1.product_name AS product_a, p2.product_name AS product_b, COUNT(*) AS together_count FROM order_details a JOIN order_details b ON b.order_id = a.order_id AND b.product_id > a.product_id JOIN products p1 ON p1.product_id = a.product_id JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = b.product_id GROUP BY p1.product_name, p2.product_name ORDER BY together_count DESC, product_a, product_b LIMIT 10;

questions.ko: 전체 매출의 80%를 차지하는 핵심 제품(ABC 분석 A등급)은 몇 개인가요?
questions.en: How many products make up the top 80% of revenue (ABC class A)?
questions.hint: 매출 = order_details.unit_price * quantity * (1 - discount). 주문 기준일은 orders.order_date. 매출 내림차순 누적 비중이 80% 이하인 제품 + 80%를 처음 넘기는 제품까지 A등급.
questions.sql: WITH pr AS (SELECT od.product_id, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM order_details od GROUP BY od.product_id), cum AS (SELECT product_id, revenue, SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) / SUM(revenue) OVER () AS cum_share, (SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id) - revenue) / SUM(revenue) OVER () AS prev_share FROM pr) SELECT COUNT(*) AS class_a_products, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pr) AS total_products FROM cum WHERE prev_share < 0.8;

turns.sql: SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Beverages' AND o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

turns.en: Which 3 customers bought the most of the top product?
turns.note: 이전 턴 결과의 1위 제품(Côte de Blaye)을 기억해야 함. 기간 조건(1997) 유지.
turns.sql: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(od.quantity) AS quantity, ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = od.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.product_name = 'Côte de Blaye' AND o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

turns.ko: 지연 배송이 가장 많은 배송사는 어디야?
turns.en: Which shipper has the most late shipments?
turns.sql: SELECT s.company_name AS shipper, COUNT(*) AS late_orders FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via WHERE o.shipped_date > o.required_date GROUP BY s.company_name ORDER BY late_orders DESC LIMIT 1;

turns.ko: 그 배송사의 지연 주문을 도착 국가별로 보여줘.
turns.en: Show that shipper's late orders by destination country.
turns.note: 이전 턴의 배송사(United Package)를 이어받아야 함.
turns.sql: SELECT o.ship_country, COUNT(*) AS late_orders, ROUND(AVG(o.shipped_date - o.required_date), 1) AS avg_days_late FROM orders o JOIN shippers s ON s.shipper_id = o.ship_via WHERE s.company_name = 'United Package' AND o.shipped_date > o.required_date GROUP BY o.ship_country ORDER BY late_orders DESC, o.ship_country;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount))::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE e.first_name = 'Margaret' AND e.last_name = 'Peacock' AND o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01';

turns.en: How does she rank against the other employees?
turns.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON od.order_id = o.order_id JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk, employee_name, ROUND(revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM s ORDER BY rnk;

edge_cases.expected: 데이터 기간이 1996-07 ~ 1998-05임을 알리고 기준 연도를 되묻거나, 데이터상 마지막 완결 연도(1997)로 가정했음을 명시.
해당 정보가 스키마에 없다고 답변. 임의의 컬럼으로 SQL 생성 금지.
customer_demographics / customer_customer_demo 테이블이 비어 있음(0건)을 설명.
조회 전용 에이전트이므로 UPDATE 거부. pgxnl validate 단계에서 DML 차단.
기준(매출 vs 수량)을 되묻거나, 가정한 기준을 명시하고 답변(매출 1위 Côte de Blaye / 수량 1위 Camembert Pierrot).

edge_cases.ko: 독일 고객 중 베를린에 있는 곳은?
edge_cases.expected: 한글 지명(독일, 베를린)을 데이터 값('Germany', 'Berlin')으로 매핑. 정답: Alfreds Futterkiste.
edge_cases.sql: SELECT company_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' AND city = 'Berlin';
